Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 92: January 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #92 shipped to subscribers in December 2008 (bearing the cover date of January 2009). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #92 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media previews:

F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin (first-person survival horror shooter)
Halo Wars (real-time strategy)
Tom Clancy's H.A.W.X. (air combat flight action)
Afro Samurai (stylish third-person action hack-and-slash)
R-Type Dimensions (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling shoot 'em up)
The Maw (Xbox Live Arcade action-adventure puzzle game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included custom downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Resident Evil 5, Street Fighter IV, and Prototype, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
